speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of colon cancer and the firm, fixed nature of this swelling accompanied by weight loss, I am concerned about metastatic disease. REQUEST TEST: CT scan of neck and chest.

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound indicates a well-circumscribed, cystic lesion in the subcutaneous tissue of the nape, which is characteristic of an epidermoid or sebaceous cyst. Given the benign imaging features and lack of systemic symptoms despite your cancer history, this is likely a benign cyst rather than metastasis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Epidermoid Cyst
